The method

Three things a program has to leave behind.

01

The lure, specific to the desk.

Finance receives an invoice. The ward receives a benefits note. The template is written for the role, in English, Spanish, or Turkish, and it is not the same mail the last client received.

02

The miss becomes a lesson the same day.

A click enrolls a module under five minutes. Reporting is the behavior the record rewards. Fifteen modules, mapped, not a library no one finishes.

03

The proof, on paper a broker will keep.

Campaigns, trend, completions, framework. Generated in a minute under the firm’s name. This is the object the renewal conversation is actually about.

Notes from the practice
01 · Against the cartoon

A ninja is a costume.

Phishing is a letter, a voice, a code on a door. The site should look like the file you hand a broker, not a booth graphic.

02 · Against the seat

Margin should widen.

Platforms that bill per person punish the firm for winning work. This engagement does the opposite.

03 · Against the demo

Ten minutes, then the mail.

Import the list. Send the lure. Teach the miss. Print the record. If that takes a procurement cycle, it is the wrong instrument.
